Place the screen on top of the remote layout, with the corporate logo placed on the top area when the screen is on top, and the microphone mounted on the top area and as small as possible; include extra two buttons for access to additional functions and LED indicators under the buttons.
Use one OK button for confirmation, one navigation button, and one Back button, with the navigation button also handling channel and volume control.
The group adopts the management directive: there will be no teletext, and only for T_V_.
